PR #27639 merged through the queue as `1346052d31c78b5ce4e76a0da75865440173813e` (head `78e68ad4`, seat ACCEPT on the PR after an independent full Fable review and a delta review). `security-owd-unset` no longer recommends `'private'` on an external object with no provable owner anchor: a writable binding gets `security-external-owner-unmapped`'s two ways out, and a read-only binding gets `'public_read'`. The stale lint header from #27476's review (should-fix 5) is fixed in the same PR. Carried: a read-only binding whose `columnMap` targets `owner_id` on a map-ignoring plugin driver keeps the `'private'` hint; that rides with #27661.
